title: refactor: layered-values-overlay + backoff-aware seed/init job for resilient private installs
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: private/on‑prem installs sometimes fail during the tenant seed/migration phase due to transient DB contention or network flakiness (airgapped pulls, registry bursts). This PR introduces two complementary changes to make installs and upgrades more resilient without changing defaults: 1) a layered values overlay mechanism that lets the installer apply environment-specific overrides (airgap, restricted-network, high-concurrency) on top of chart values; 2) a backoff-aware, idempotent seed/init job implementation with controlled retries and install-phase markers so a failed run can be resumed safely.

What this change does (single-string body): - Adds chart/values.schema.json additions for `seed` and `overlay` namespaces (seed.retryPolicy, seed.maxRetries, seed.backoffSeconds, overlay.profiles). The overlay system supports a simple precedence model: base values <- profile overlay <- installer-supplied patch. - Introduces templates/chart/templates/seed-job.yaml: a job which consults a small init container `seed-runner` that writes a status marker to a ConfigMap and respects backoff policy and jitter. The job uses a non-default backoffLimit derived from values and emits structured logs for monitoring and rollback decisions. - Adds templates/_overlay_helpers.tpl helper used to render (1) profile merge annotation, (2) safe defaulting for retry/backoff, and (3) a `seedResumeKey` annotation used by the private-operator to detect resumable seed state. - Adds scripts/seed-runner.sh: small POSIX script used by the init container to perform idempotent seeding (uses SQL idempotency tokens / k8s object existence checks so repeated runs are safe). Script supports dry-run and verbose logging. - Adds templates/preflight-cron.yaml to optionally schedule a lightweight preflight check that can gate whether the seed job should run immediately or be deferred (useful for slow registries). - Updates README and installer docs with examples for overlay profiles and recommended policies for large clusters.

Checklist: - [x] values.schema entries added and validated by helm schema test - [x] seed job template covers resume and annotation - [x] seed-runner script includes idempotency token and is POSIX-compatible for minimal base image - [x] integration test that simulates transient DB failure and verifies resume semantics - [x] docs updated with example overlays and roll-forward instructions

Compatibility notes: defaults are conservative (maxRetries: 3, backoffSeconds: 30). Overlay profiles are additive and opt-in; existing installs that do not set `overlay.profiles` will behave exactly as before. The new seed annotations are optional and ignored by older operators; the private-operator will be patched in a follow-up change to honor `seedResumeKey` for automated resume/cleanup. See ENG-1142 for follow-up operator work.

release_notes: Add layered values overlays and resilient seed/init job with configurable retry/backoff; defaults are conservative and opt-in via overlay profiles.
notes_for_ops: Operators: when using airgapped registries, apply an overlay profile that sets overlay.profiles: [\"airgap\"] and seed.backoffSeconds to a higher value (default 30s). If using private-operator automation, wait for ENG-1142 operator update before enabling automated resume.
